redstone_trail.title: Redstone Trail
redstone_trail.clear_hint: Clears the current trail and stops recording. Saved comparison trails are kept.
redstone_trail.radius_hint: 16 / 32 / 64 / 128 blocks, centered on your position when recording starts. Stop recording to change the radius.
redstone_trail.started: Trail recording started · /rt to stop or clear
redstone_trail.stopped_temporary: Recording stopped · temporary marks still expire.
redstone_trail.limit: Trail limit reached · stopped and kept existing marks
redstone_trail.load_failed: Cannot read trails · original file preserved
redstone_trail.save_failed: Save failed · trails remain in memory
redstone_trail.hint0: 1. Start recording, then activate a lever or button.
redstone_trail.hint1: 2. Changed blocks keep an orange outline.
redstone_trail.hint2: 3. Trails survive stop and reconnect. Clear to erase.
redstone_trail.hint3: All state changes in range · received server updates only
redstone_trail.name: Name
redstone_trail.fade_hint.over_lifetime: Fade from activation until the lifetime ends.
redstone_trail.fade_hint.instant: Stay fully visible, then disappear at expiry.
redstone_trail.fade_hint.after_duration: Stay for the lifetime, then fade for the extra duration.
redstone_trail.temporary_hint0: Each block uses its latest activation; reactivation resets time.
redstone_trail.temporary_hint1: Stop / hide do not pause time. Saved trails stay visible.
redstone_trail.temporary_hint2: Temporary marks are not restored after reconnecting.
redstone_trail.snapshot_hint0: Keep a separate snapshot of the current remaining trail.
redstone_trail.snapshot_hint1: Saved trails do not expire. Edit their appearance separately.
redstone_trail.snapshot_limit: Needs a trail · max 16 snapshots / 32,768 saved blocks
redstone_trail.no_saved: Use Save comparison to keep the current trail.
redstone_trail.delete_hint: Deletes only this snapshot. Other trails are kept.
redstone_trail.main_hint: Show several saved trails together to compare their paths.
